confidence_notes: Lijiang cost-of-living data support the meal, beer and coffee estimates. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated from typical bar markups over beer, and July accommodation prices are broad model estimates. The latest exact RBA USD rate retrievable here was dated 2026-10-12.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Lijiang cost-of-living data with China-wide restaurant benchmarks; accommodation is modeled for a tourist-oriented Yunnan destination in summer.
